title: Eggless housewarming cakes near Camellia and Rosehill — from Harris Park
summary:
A griha pravesh in Camellia or Rosehill needs a cake every guest can eat — Jain, vegetarian, halal-friendly — without anyone checking the box first.

That's not a special request at Num Nums. It's the default. Every cake we bake is 100% eggless, which is why Jain and vegetarian families across Parramatta don't have to ask.

Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache — any design, photo references welcome. 48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes.

Harris Park store, open until 10pm daily. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
